neighbours.label: the tokens ' Chrysler' and ' clich' (cliché): a lexical pair, no shared meaning
fire: The company sold its Detroit plant to Chrysler in 1980.
He restored an old Chrysler convertible.
My father worked at Chrysler for thirty years.
The new Chrysler minivan has sliding doors.
The ending is a worn cliché about true love.
Critics called the plot one big cliché.
That phrase has become a cliché in politics.
Avoid every cliché when you write your speech.
